caveat: Exploratory development OOF analyses after model selection. 2,000 site/class-stratified patient bootstrap resamples condition on fitted models and class/site counts; exclude retraining and model-selection uncertainty. Threshold optima and gating are not independently validated. Multiple comparisons are unadjusted.

threshold_stability.note: Distribution of reselected apparent thresholds, not an interval for the externally optimal threshold.

threshold_transfer_diagnostic.caveat: Other OOF folds select each cutoff, but their generating models may have trained on target-fold patients. Diagnostic only; not independent or nested validation.

gating_caveat: Retained-subset performance is conditional on selection. Deferred patients are not correct predictions. Raw disagreement/margin are not calibrated confidence; cutoffs require independent validation.
